name: Extreme Television Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice in the surviving record, once on camera by a fan-supplied chair shot and once by an undocumented transition, and was still held when the collection's own record ends.

name: Extreme World Championship
epitaph: Held by the same wrestler for the whole of the surviving record, called "the Internet championship" once and "the Extreme World Title" thereafter by the federation's own inconsistent usage.

name: Extreme Internet Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on camera in March, passed unseen to a wrestler who later quit the federation mid-show, and was awarded a second time to the winner of the federation's own year-end battle royal.

name: World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by three different teams across three surviving cards, twice retained by disqualification or restart rather than changing hands cleanly.

name: US Title
epitaph: Created at the federation's own year-end battle royal and awarded, in the same match, alongside the vacant Extreme Internet Championship.
